sequential_dependency.intermediate: The selected axis plus ordered line records containing the pair color, period, residue, and optional marker coordinate/color.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Count same-color pairs on both axes, choose the majority axis, and derive each pair period, residue, and unique aligned marker.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Use each record and the episode marker policy to choose paint color and extent, then render the arithmetic progression.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The cells painted by B are not fixed by the original pair endpoints alone: changing the derived global axis or period changes which progressions exist and therefore changes the final grid.

parametric_work.summary: Authored and preflighted a periodic-signal family with canonical marker resolution, full pair-extension alternative, strict sequential public projection, finite rivals, and a protected opposite-axis causal witness.
